channel.title: Rugspull Evidence Updates
channel.description: Dated, risk-first Rugspull evidence and operating-gate updates. Not live analytics, investment advice, an audit, or a safety signal.

item.title: Office Counter report 010 — 2026-07-19
item.description: Search Console accepted the 43-URL sitemap and reports 43 discovered pages. The new invariant-testing guide is discovered but not indexed, with sitemap.xml recognized, no referring page or last crawl, and a priority indexing request accepted. IndexNow accepted 54 URLs. Discovery and request receipts do not prove indexing, ranking, clicks, approval, audit, adoption, or endorsement.

item.title: What are smart contract invariants?
item.description: A Builder guide to Rugspull's 12-action Foundry state machine, seven conservation and lifecycle properties, 128-run by 64-depth configuration, and the limits of project-authored invariant evidence.

item.title: What are alternative pools on BNB Chain?
item.description: A venue-separation guide to canonical RugPool identity, external pools, independent reserves and prices, routing, approvals, LP controls, aggregators, and cross-market execution risk.

item.title: Why is Cloudflare D1 not financial truth?
item.description: A Builder guide separating D1 discovery and event-derived market caches from authoritative contract state, receipts, balances, action gating, and wallet-signed settlement.

item.title: Why does verified source code not mean audited?
item.description: A review guide separating bytecode/source correspondence from independent security assessment, including compiler settings, deployment configuration, multi-contract scope, project-authored tests, and the evidence required for a real audit claim.

item.title: What does MEV mean for a BNB Chain AMM swap?
item.description: A risk-first guide to transaction ordering, stale reserve quotes, minimum output, deadlines, atomic reverts, fees, the full Founder sale, and separate alternative pools. These controls do not guarantee inclusion, fair sequencing, price, liquidity, an exit, or safety.

item.title: How to verify AMM reserves on BscScan
item.description: A source-first guide to deriving the canonical RugPool, reading stored RugToken and WBNB reserves, reconciling actual balances and Swap events, and separating surplus or alternative pools. Correct reconciliation is not an audit, liquidity guarantee, or safety verdict.

item.title: What does liquidity mean in a BNB Chain AMM?
item.description: A risk-first guide to token and WBNB reserve depth, price impact, Opening liquidity, the full Founder sale, stored-reserve reconciliation, and separate alternative pools. Liquidity does not guarantee price, execution, an exit, recovery, an audit, or safety.

item.title: How does a constant-product AMM calculate swaps?
item.description: A mechanism guide to stored RugToken/WBNB reserves, x times y, post-fee amount-out arithmetic, integer rounding, nondecreasing k, price impact, and direct-transfer surplus. A deterministic curve is not a liquidity, price, execution, audit, or safety guarantee.

item.title: What does slippage tolerance do on BNB Chain?
item.description: A risk-first guide to current-state estimates, constant-product price impact, minimum output, 20-minute deadlines, atomic reverts, and why wider tolerance cannot create liquidity or guarantee execution.
